#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;

    if (w <= 3) {
        cout << "YES\n";
        return 0;
    }

    const long long limit = 10000000000LL;
    vector<long long> powers;
    long long x = 1;
    while (x <= limit) {
        powers.push_back(x);
        x *= w;
    }

    int n = powers.size();
    long long* a = powers.data();

    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) {
        long long v = m;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (i & (1 << j)) {
                v += a[j];
            }
        }
        for (int j = n - 1; j >= 0; --j) {
            if (!(i & (1 << j))) {
                if (v >= a[j]) {
                    v -= a[j];
                }
            }
        }
        if (v == 0) {
            cout << "YES\n";
            return 0;
        }
    }

    cout << "NO\n";
    return 0;
}
